title: flow_summary.spawned is derived two different ways by the two golden writers
evidence:
tests/spine_check.cpp:641:
			static_cast<int>(State.Flow.Packets.size()) + State.Score, // spawned = delivered + live

Source/PacketPlumberEditor/PPProbeCommandlet.cpp:137:
			ReachablePairs, TotalHops, static_cast<int32>(State.Flow.Demand.size()), State.Score,

docs/goldens/SCHEMA.md:45:
| `flow_summary.spawned` | int | demand entries fired (packets constructed) |
detail: spine-check reports spawned as live+delivered; PPProbe reports total Demand.size(). Equal (11) for the current golden, but diverge under demand scheduled past the run end or future packet drops — a confusing gate-7 failure, not silent.
recommended_fix: Pick one derivation (a counted spawn in FFlowState, or Demand fired <= Tick) and use it in both writers; tighten SCHEMA.md's 'demand entries fired (packets constructed)' wording to match.

title: Bare same-tick re-step is allowed yet mutates state (double-serves flow, advances RNG)
detail: Step(S,T) twice with no commands falls through: FlowStep re-runs (on-edge packets served twice at one tick) and the nonce redraws. Non-idempotent; a harness re-stepping silently diverges replay-equality, asymmetric with the with-commands latch.
recommended_fix: Make a bare same-tick re-step a no-op (return after the guards) or assert state immobility in the spine-check test that pins its legality; current harnesses are monotonic so risk is latent.
